name: digit_run_vectors
verdict: refused is true when the string, as a value at a path that has no exemption of its own, holds a run of more than four digits (digits are Unicode Nd; the separators in a row join them; a comma ends a run) and is not a whole money string. The Record guard (payloadguard.Check), the model service's redactor (mask_account_numbers changes the string) and the UI scan (scanVisibleText reports digit-run) must each give this verdict for every vector. A vector with exemption money is accepted only because the whole string is a money string: its longest run is over four.

money_rule.note: [A-Z] and [0-9] are ASCII only; the end of the pattern is the end of the string, not before a final newline
